stories.summary: A procedure intended to clear her uterus after a failed pregnancy was expected to end her ordeal. Instead, the woman continued bleeding for weeks, eventually requiring a third procedure and a blood transfusion at a hospital in another city. stories.title: Maharashtra FDA commissioner warns against unlicensed sale of whey protein, misleading health claims
stories.summary: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe on Monday (November 23, 2026) warned of stringent action against gym operators selling health supplements without requisite authorisation and manufacturers making misleading claims about their health benefits, following a State-wide compliance order aimed at regulating the manufacture, marketing and sale of nutraceutical products.

stories.title: Diabetes warning signs: Doctors explain 7 early symptoms young adults should not ignore

stories.summary: The best packaging depends on the food and how you use it. Know which one suits each kind of food. Ever wondered how best to store the cereal you opened last week? stories.title: Kannale brought back to Parappana Agrahara jail after hospital stay
stories.summary: Basavaraj Kannale, an accused in the KPSC recruitment scam, was brought back to Parappana Agrahara Central Prison after prison authorities found that he did not require inpatient treatment at Victoria Hospital, where he had been admitted citing severe knee pain. stories.summary: Cold weather, hot showers and harsh scrubbing can worsen winter dryness and irritation. stories.summary: Dr Amber Aggrwal highlights the importance of taking antibiotics as advised by a doctor during pregnancy to treat infections if they arise. Women undergo significant physiological changes during pregnancy that can affect the immune system and make them prone to infections.

stories.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes and Australian batter Cameron Bancroft are among the overseas players who have registered for the IPL auction, news agency PTI reported. stories.summary: Harbhajan Singh has urged the International Cricket Council and the respective cricket Boards to rein in player behaviour after recent skirmishes between India and Pakistan at the under-19 and A levels. stories.summary: India Under-19 Asia Cup-winning stars Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva have registered for the IPL 2027 auction after their impressive performances in the tournament, as per reports from Cricbuzz . stories.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup hosts

stories.title: AFC Champions League Two: East Bengal takes on Al-Hussein in a must-win tie

stories.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom
stories.summary: Donald Trump awarded Rudy Giuliani, his former personal attorney who was disbarred for his efforts to help the US president overturn 2020 election results , with the presidential medal of freedom on Tuesday. “I am honored and humbled to receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom from my nation and from President Donald J Trump,” Giuliani, 82, wrote in an X post hours after the award had been presented to him.

stories.title: Women’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026: Deepika’s Stunning Hat-Trick Powers India To 6-2 Victory Over China
stories.summary: FP photo Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): It was Deepika's night, India's delight and Bhopal's hockey festival! A sensational first-quarter hat-trick from Deepika powered the hosts to a commanding 6-2 demolition of China in the Madhya Pradesh Women's Asian Champions Trophy at the International Sports Complex on Tuesday.

stories.title: IPL Auction: Aaryavir Sehwag, Ben Stokes in draft register; Anvay Dravid, Mustafizur Rahman miss out
stories.summary: Aaryavir Sehwag, son of former India opener Virender Sehwag, is among the notable names in the IPL auction register, which features several members of India’s recent Under-19 Asia Cup-winning squad. stories.title: PT Usha out of IOA president's race, Gagan Narang, Virendra Sachdeva in fray
stories.summary: A relatively new-look Indian Olympic Association (IOA) is on the cards. stories.title: The Sooryavanshi phenomenon: 204 off 53 and a glimpse of cricket's future
stories.summary: Flat and hard… the sixes were already travelling 75-80 metres. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, barely 11 years old then, was still in the practice phase of his development when childhood coach Manish Ojha decided to test him against a group of senior players at his academy in 2022.

stories.summary: India A captain Tilak Varma was left short of words after witnessing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's breathtaking 204-run assault against the UAE in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. stories.title: PWL Season 6 to be held in Delhi from January 3-19
stories.summary: The Pro Wrestling League (PWL) has announced the revised schedule for Season 6, which will now be held from January 3 to 19 at the KD Jadhav stadium here. stories.summary: Imagine Deepti Sharma bowling to Glenn Phillips, or Smriti Mandhana taking strike against Nandre Burger . stories.title: CM to open ‘Vision Koyilandy Conclave 2026’ on Nov. 27
stories.summary: D. Satheesan will open ‘Vision Koyilandy Conclave 2026’, an event to chalk out future development plans for the Koyilandy Assembly constituency in Kozhikode district, on November 27. stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.
